notes:
Summary:
- Target: private VPC deployment for production inference of customer-facing chat + internal compliance search.
- Primary constraint: EU data residency (eu-west-1) + SOC2/ISO27001 evidence.
- Encryption posture focus: in-transit (mutual TLS), at-rest (AES-256-GCM with envelope encryption), key lifecycle and secrets ops.

Security review / technical asks (high level):
- mTLS between customer application and Redwood ingress: customer will provision client certs via their PKI; Redwood to validate CN and OU. Confirmed support for TLS1.3 + mTLS in PoC.
- Backend-to-backend (intra-cluster) traffic: require link-level encryption + service identity. Redwood proposed mutual-auth over mTLS + short-lived service certs.
- At-rest encryption: envelope encryption with customer-managed keys (CMK). Preference for AWS KMS with automatic rotation + HSM-backed keys (FIPS 140-2).
- Key rotation: customer requires 90-day rotation for data encryption keys, annual rotation for CMKs or on-demand via key alias swap. Need documented rotation runbook.
- Secrets management: customer runs HashiCorp Vault for service secrets and wants Redwood to integrate via PKI/Role-based access. They asked for ephemeral tokens and automatic revocation hooks.
- Audit logging: full request/response metadata (no PII in logs) forwarded to customer's Splunk instance; retention 7 years for compliance team. Need mapping of Redwood audit fields to SIEM schema.
- Backup snapshots: must verify encryption at-rest and residency for snapshots; legal asked for clause that snapshots never leave eu-west-1.
- HSM requirement: legal/crypto team insists on HSM-backed CMKs. Vendor evaluation in progress; customer asked whether Redwood supports customer-provided HSM (bring-your-own HSM).

- 2025-11-18: Intro demo with Marcus/Liam — customer liked console and routing policies.
- 2026-01-12: Security questionnaire (30+ pages) submitted; Redwood answered initial 75%.

- 2026-03-08: PoC first results: mTLS handshake OK, average tail-latency 170ms (chat path) — below desired sub-150ms SLO. Redwood engineering researching batching/edge routing tweak to reduce 20-30ms. Ticket RI-3302 created.
